case_number: CIVIL APPEAL NO. 3155 OF 2023; SLP (C) NO. 10653 OF 2018

parties.respondent: The State of Bihar and Ors.

summary: Work charged employees' pension computation; counting of service: one year for every five years under work charged tenure for pension eligibility; entire service not to be counted for pension quantum; regularization under Rules, 2013; distinction upheld between regular and work charged employees; Prem Singh case distinguished; High Court's Larger Bench decision affirmed.
legal_provisions_cited: Work Charged Establishment Revised Service Conditions (Repealing) Rules, 2013, Rule 5(v)
Prem Singh Vs. State of Uttar Pradesh and Ors., (2019) 10 SCC 516
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; impugned judgment upholding Rule 5(v) of Rules, 2013 affirmed.
